findings.detail: The registry retains the DevicePolicyAdmission object but not independently captured identities of its original phase, blobs and expected_pins. Frozen dataclass fields can be rebound through object.__setattr__, within the same callback-mutation boundary addressed by the other retained owners. _context then authenticates the current coherent fields, _caller derives source/hook bindings from them, and _hook supplies those current phase/blob values. Equal-content replacements can pass pure authentication; a coherent different policy could also rebase unless the external process hook rejects it.
findings.minimal_repair: Capture the original three fields before any fallible check/callback, retain them with the attempt, compare their identities before reauthentication and after callbacks, and invoke source-fixed hooks with those captured original values. Reject rather than rebase on replacement. Preserve current5 unchanged and use a declared source successor.
findings.scope: This does not establish actual authority bypass: the documented process hook must independently enforce original identities, current server hooks/policies are absent, and selected complete-capacity still denies. Nevertheless the component does not locally meet its stated original-input/one-permit invariant.
findings.status: concrete source-only local invariant gap; no execution or bypass demonstration

source_conclusions: Ten immutable canonical bounded documents are externally hashed and joined to exact phase/source/archive/dependency/resource hashes; resource selection and allocator links, workspace request/source joins,14 review subjects and exclusive lease links are explicit. No default numerical allowance, self-issued grant or hash-only policy fallback is supplied.

Source-fixed hook lookup requires five top-level Python functions with exact module/global/code origins, no defaults or closures, and retained process module/spec/function/code identities. Independent helper-source origins/hashes and the hook binding contract remain necessary; this is not arbitrary-Python/native containment.

Registry insertion precedes initial callbacks and retains the policy/returned owners on failure. Second issuance during capture/busy and nested public transitions poison the attempt; _hook checks busy after the callback, so a caught nested hook transition cannot restore a permitted/observed state through that hook path.

Initialization precedes ordered post_init/post_keys/pre_evaluation/terminal observations. Statistics require explicit bytes_in_use/bytes_limit, exact nonnegative integers, consistent limits and reviewed additional/workspace/reserve comparison; no missing-stat fallback or reservation is claimed.

The selected device/JAX class, memory_stats descriptor/method, selection callables, original default-device identity and one-device/process checks remain explicit. Actual native semantics, exclusivity, synchronization and complete workspace bounds are independent factual/process-hook prerequisites, not proven by this component.

Clean retirement removes only the guard registry after terminal observation. Hardware/default-device/array/lease retirement remains with original process/external owners; failed attempts remain retained and no retry is granted.
